name: Camping-Stadler
beschreibung: The campsite Camping-Stadler is nestled along the shores of Lake Waginger See in the alpine foothills, roughly 20 kilometres west of Traunstein. Featuring direct lake access, the property is enveloped by lush meadows and woods. Guests benefit from well-kept pitches for motorhomes and tents, rental accommodation, modern sanitary amenities, a shop, and an on-site lakeside restaurant. The village of Petting provides a beach resort and serves as a trailhead for walks in the Rupertiwinkel.
